nodes.name: Format error
nodes.notes: Keeps the last 50 crash notes in this workflow's own static data. The executions list is the full log.

nodes.name: Notify Slack
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. This is a separate workflow, so it needs its own Slack credential selection.

parameters.content:
## Error workflow

Import this beside the lead agent, then open the lead agent settings and choose this workflow as the error workflow.

n8n only runs it when an execution crashes. The lead agent already answers the webhook from its own error branch for bad input, bad JSON, and Claude HTTP failures.
